title: CanonicalPlayExtraction
description: Documents a built-in play extracted from a specific game's playbook. Used to prove a play exists in-game and to map it to a library play_id.

source_game.description: Game profile id, e.g. 'madden-05-ps2'. Must match a file in data/games/.

source_playbook.description: Playbook name as shown in the game UI, e.g. 'New England Patriots' or 'Auburn'.

source_play_call.description: Play name exactly as shown in the game's play call screen, e.g. 'HB Dive', 'PA Cross'.

source_formation.description: Formation name as shown in game, e.g. 'I Formation', 'Singleback'.

extracted_date.description: ISO date when this extraction was performed (YYYY-MM-DD).

library_play_id.description: The play_id in data/plays/ that best matches this in-game play. Use null if no match exists yet.

match_confidence.description: How closely the in-game play matches the library play: 'exact' = identical design, 'close' = same concept with minor differences, 'approximate' = similar enough to use as reference, 'none' = new play needed.

screenshot_ref.description: Optional path or URL to a screenshot proving this extraction.

transcribed_assignments.description: Per-player assignments as read from the game editor. Mirrors the assignments format in play.schema.json.

differences_from_library.description: List of differences between the in-game play and the library play_id.

verification_status.description: Use 'verified' only if extracted directly from in-game (with screenshot proof). 'inferred' for web-sourced info. 'unverified' for all else.
